title: How should small-sample route qualification be computed for multi-item cases?
summary: policy routing.qualification_rule uses the Wilson lower bound of the per-call validator pass rate with min_samples_for_qualification = 10. For a 20-item case set that needs >= 10 calls per route before anything can qualify; pooled item-level intervals (items_wilson95, now reported by orchestrate eval) qualify faster but treat repeated items as independent. The policy is a protected path, so the operator decides whether qualification may use pooled item-level intervals, and with what correction.

provenance.author_tier: frontier (Opus 5.5) analysis of deterministic eval output
